title: Additional individual wines
note: Curated, individually sourced producer bottlings. These are not marked as wines the user has tried; source notes and suggestions are identified. Bottle images are sourced externally.

wines.intro: A classic oak-aged Rioja Reserva marrying ripe forest fruit with earthy spice and polished structure.
wines.nose: Wild blackberries, blueberries and subtle undergrowth and oak spice.
wines.palate: Concentrated yet fresh, firm silky tannins, integrated oak and a smooth fruit-driven core.
wines.finish: Long and aromatic with persistent ripe berries.
wines.aeration: A 20–40 minute decant can highlight its fruit.
wines.personalNote: Winery describes intense clean fruit, undergrowth, silky structured tannins and long balanced finish.
wines.pairingBasis: Muga explicitly suggests ribeye, charcuterie and casseroles.
wines.imageVintageNote: Genuine winery bottle packshot; illustrated label may not identify the 2022 vintage.
wines.vintageNote: Winery tasting text describes 2022; photography may represent the current label.

wines.intro: Plush Napa Merlot with concentrated dark red fruit, polished tannins and floral depth.
wines.nose: Dark red berries, plum and flowers with light baking spice.
wines.palate: Supple, refined texture, red cherry and plum with integrated Cabernet structure.
wines.aeration: About 20 minutes in a decanter helps young Napa Merlot.
wines.personalNote: The 2022 winemaker notes emphasize floral dark berry aromatics, polished fruit and seamless tannin integration.
wines.pairingBasis: Ribeye is suggested in a professional tasting; remaining matches follow the wine's texture and fruit.
wines.imageVintageNote: Producer bottle photo currently shows a 2023 anniversary label; profile describes the 2022 vintage.
wines.vintageNote: The photographed label is 2023, not 2022. Wine profile is the 2022 blend and winemaking notes.

wines.intro: A precise Napa Chardonnay combining ripe stone fruit, citrus tension and restrained barrel detail.
wines.nose: Peach, apricot, kiwi, orange blossom and fresh flowers.
wines.palate: Mandarin, Meyer lemon and lemon verbena, with crisp apple and subtle graham cracker spice.
wines.finish: Pear, citrus zest and a touch of ginger.
wines.aeration: Serve cool but not icy, with a broad white-wine glass.
wines.personalNote: Matt Crafton's 2022 notes emphasize pure stone fruit, a linear citrus palate and delicate toasted oak nuances.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions to match citrus freshness and subtle oak.
wines.imageVintageNote: Official Chateau Montelena 2022 Chardonnay bottle image.
wines.vintageNote: Wine and bottle image both reference the 2022 vintage.

wines.intro: A refreshing organic Soave offering floral citrus, almond nuance and a saline volcanic-soil character.
wines.nose: Almond blossom, marzipan, elderflower, bergamot and pear.
wines.palate: Supple orchard fruit balanced by zesty acidity and subtle savory salinity.
wines.aeration: Serve slightly chilled; fresh floral notes emerge in the glass.
wines.personalNote: The winery's Soave Classico profile highlights almond and white flowers, pear, citrus and a fresh saline palate.
wines.pairingBasis: Winery recommends vegetable starters, soups and seafood; risotto is a complementary sommelier choice.
wines.vintageNote: 2023 bottle photograph; winery's general house notes can vary across vintages.

wines.intro: An elegant bone-dry Alsace Riesling with mineral clarity, citrus and orchard fruit.
wines.nose: Lemon and lime, spring flowers and delicate pear.
wines.palate: Juicy, taut and dry, with high acid and subtle pear-skin grip.
wines.finish: Crisp and mineral with lingering lemon.
wines.aeration: Serve lightly chilled in a white-wine glass; no decanting needed.
wines.personalNote: Hugel describes its 2023 Classic as dry, elegant and especially suited to seafood.
wines.pairingBasis: The winery names fish and seafood; sushi is a suggested extension.
wines.sourceLabel: Famille Hugel Classic Riesling 2023 technical profile
wines.imageVintageNote: Same Hugel Classic Riesling cuvée; retailer photo file is labeled 2022.
wines.vintageNote: Tasting reference is the producer's 2023 release, pictured label may represent 2022.

wines.intro: A high-altitude Malbec showing fresh berries, violets and a mineral-textured palate.
wines.nose: Fresh red fruit, flowers, mountain herbs, spice and mint.
wines.palate: Medium-bodied with ripe, firm tannins and juicy fruit.
wines.aeration: Give this young Malbec 20–30 minutes to open.
wines.personalNote: Sebastián Zuccardi's 2022 technical sheet emphasizes floral and herbal aromatics and fresh ripe tannins.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for youthful Malbec and grilled foods.
wines.sourceLabel: Zuccardi Q Malbec 2022 official technical sheet
wines.imageVintageNote: Retailer packshot of Zuccardi Q Valle de Uco Malbec 2022.

wines.intro: A finely balanced, Chardonnay-led Champagne with delicacy, citrus freshness and soft toasty complexity.
wines.nose: White flowers, delicate fruit, brioche and hints of honey.
wines.palate: Fine bubbles, crisp orchard fruit and a creamy measured texture.
wines.aeration: Serve chilled in a tulip glass; do not decant.
wines.personalNote: Taittinger's house notes describe a refined Brut Réserve combining Chardonnay lift with fine bubbles and floral fruit.
wines.pairingBasis: Seafood and lighter canapés suit this fresh non-vintage blend.
wines.sourceLabel: Champagne Taittinger official Brut Réserve profile
wines.imageVintageNote: Official Taittinger Brut Réserve bottle packshot.
wines.vintageNote: Non-vintage Champagne; composition is adjusted over releases.

wines.intro: A structured Champagne built on Pinot Noir with mature orchard fruit, spicy complexity and fine bubbles.
wines.nose: Roasted apple, peach compote and warm spice.
wines.palate: Velvety bubbles, pear, brioche and a subtle walnut note.
wines.aeration: Serve in a tulip glass, preferably not straight from the freezer.
wines.personalNote: Bollinger's producer notes describe ripe fruit and a structured, velvety mouthfeel with brioche and spicy aromas.
wines.pairingBasis: Bollinger specifically recommends fish, sushi, seafood, poultry and cured ham.
wines.sourceLabel: Bollinger Special Cuvée official winemaking and pairing notes
wines.imageVintageNote: Authentic Special Cuvée non-vintage bottle image.
wines.vintageNote: A multi-vintage blend with reserve wine; proportions can evolve by release.

wines.intro: Mountain-grown traditional-method Chardonnay with crisp apple, floral lift and bready lees complexity.
wines.nose: Ripe Golden Delicious apple, white flowers and a delicate yeast note.
wines.palate: Lively, elegant bubbles with orchard fruit and crusty bread.
wines.aeration: Chill before opening and pour into a tulip-shaped glass.
wines.personalNote: Ferrari's technical sheet describes fresh apples, wild flowers and a delicate yeasty undertone.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for mineral, Chardonnay-led traditional-method fizz.
wines.vintageNote: Non-vintage wine; bottle image represents house labeling.

wines.intro: A supple southern Rhône blend with generous cherry fruit, soft spice and savory garrigue.
wines.nose: Black cherry, ripe red berries, pepper and wild herbs.
wines.palate: Fleshy plum fruit, soft silky tannins and a touch of earth.
wines.aeration: Serve slightly cool; short aeration is optional.
wines.personalNote: Famille Perrin identifies a fresh, fruit-forward southern Rhône red with rounded tannins and peppery spice.
wines.pairingBasis: Winery recommends roasted poultry, grilled meats, hearty stews and charcuterie.
wines.sourceLabel: Famille Perrin official Côtes du Rhône Réserve description
wines.imageVintageNote: Official wine product bottle image; bottle year and closure may differ.
wines.vintageNote: General producer tasting information; no single vintage is asserted.

wines.intro: A pale Provençal rosé marrying floral perfume with fleshy peach fruit and a mineral-saline finish.
wines.palate: Silky orchard fruit with firm freshness and mineral tension.
wines.personalNote: The 2023 technical sheet highlights floral perfume, peach, silky tension and a saline, mineral finish.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions matching rosé's acidity to seafood, herbs and light cured meat.
wines.imageVintageNote: Matching Miraval Provence bottle image; vintage on retail photograph may vary.
wines.vintageNote: Profile is specifically 2023; linked product bottle image may show another release.

wines.intro: A distinctive Lebanese red with savory depth, dark fruit, herbal spice and age-worthy texture.
wines.nose: Red cherry, plum, aromatic spice and a leather-like savory note.
wines.palate: Blackberry, cherry and warming spice over textured, velvety tannins.
wines.aeration: For young bottles, consider decanting to open the aromas.
wines.personalNote: Musar's classic Bekaa blend is often marked by complex savory character alongside dark berry fruit.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier recommendations for a structured savory red.
wines.sourceLabel: 2019 Château Musar Rouge importer wine profile
wines.imageVintageNote: Bottle photo identified as Château Musar Rouge 2019.
wines.vintageNote: 2019 source label and grape blend; maturation and flavor profile can evolve significantly with cellaring.

wines.intro: Generous Lodi old-vine Zinfandel with ripe berry depth, sweet spice and supple tannins.
wines.nose: Black cherry, strawberry, subtle vanilla and toasted spice.
wines.palate: Juicy dark fruit layered with star anise, clove and chocolate-like richness.
wines.finish: Warm spice and gentle supple tannins.
wines.aeration: A short decant helps open sweet spices.
wines.personalNote: The producer's 2022 distributor sheet emphasizes ripe red and black fruit, spice and a juicy finish.
wines.pairingBasis: The official distributor suggests roast pork, smoky BBQ and spicy stew; pictured pairing examples reflect rich fruit.
wines.sourceLabel: Cline Old Vine Zinfandel 2022 importer technical sheet
wines.imageVintageNote: Authentic Cline Old Vine Zinfandel bottle packshot; vintage label may differ.
wines.vintageNote: Taste profile is the 2022 wine; product bottle image may not show the same vintage.

wines.intro: A rich but balanced southern Rhône red with dark fruit, pepper and silky tannins.
wines.nose: Blackcurrant, black cherry, ripe plum and licorice.
wines.palate: Full, smooth and layered with dark fruit and spice.
wines.aeration: Decant briefly if serving very young.
wines.personalNote: The producer's 2022 technical sheet describes dark fruits, spice, a round palate and elegant finishing tannins.
wines.pairingBasis: Producer recommends charcuterie, braised dishes and richer meats.
wines.sourceLabel: Guigal Côtes du Rhône Rouge 2022 technical profile
wines.imageVintageNote: Guigal Côtes du Rhône bottle catalog image; current label may vary.
wines.vintageNote: 2022 specific producer tasting notes; photograph not guaranteed to show its vintage.
